clips.title: The story
paras: Near the Greymane Wall in Silverpine Forest, Dalin Forgewright patrols with an honorable heart.

Undercity warlocks seek hearts from truly virtuous mortals to call and bind a succubus to their service. Dalin Forgewright spends his days defending desperate Lordaeron refugees kept from safety by the sealed Greymane Wall. His selfless devotion marks him as a rare offering of unblemished purity, and his heart is carved for the rites held in the Temple of the Damned.
